title.narrative: Strengthening the M&E system of the National Strategy for Growth and Reduction of Poverty

description.narrative: Development Objective The objective of this IDF operation is to strengthen the capacity of the Poverty Monitoring Secretariat of the Ministry of Planningcomma Economy & Empowerment to coordinate the implementation of the NSGRP M&E plan. Component 1: Improvement of the NSGRP Results Framework 1. Refining the NSGRP Results Framework. Assist the PMS Secretariat (in the PED) in coordinating with the sectorscomma the President's Office for Planning and Privatization (PO-PP)comma and the Ministry of Financecomma and the donors to develop and define indicators to complete the results matrix for NSGRP. 2. Aligning Sector and Local Government Strategies with the NSGRP. Technical assistance will be provided to sectors and Local Government to align their strategies and plans with the NSGRPcomma and develop and implement programs that are aligned with the NSGRP results framework. Component 2: Strengthening NSGRP M&E systems 3. Development of detailed M&E plan for each NSGRP outcome indicator. 4. Strengthening the sector and Local Government M&E Systems. Assist selected sectors and Local Government Authorities (LGA) to develop effective M&E systems. Focus will be on sectors and LGA with weak systems. Component 3: Strengthening NSGRP Implementation Reporting and Review Mechanism 5. Annual NSGRP Report. Assist the Secretariat (PED) in strengthening the Annual Review Mechanism. Component 4: Capacity building in M&E. 6. M&E training and skill development. This grant will assist selected partners involved in the implementation of the NSGRP M&E plan in skill development at the national and local levels. Likely Outcomes of Project Activities 1. A complete results matrix for the NSGRP that brings together key elements of Sector Strategic Plans and Local Authority Planscomma highlighting key areas for implementation. 2. An implemented data collection plan leading to the regular reporting of required data for monitoring of NSGRP outcomes. 3. Improved annual review mechanism that produces useful information for monitoring the performance of NSGRP outcomescomma and that encourages the use of this information for continuous improvement of development policies and programs. The objective of this IDF grant is to build capacity of the Government of Tanzania in Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E). The IDF grant will be housed within the Ministry of Planningcomma Economy and Empowerment (MPEE) to align with the Government established Technical Assistance Facility.
